name: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon
short_description: A full marathon and half marathon held in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam on November 22, 2026, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is a full marathon scheduled for November 22, 2026, in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam. The event offers both a 42.195 km marathon distance and a 21.1 km half marathon option, giving runners a choice based on their fitness and goals. Registration for the race is currently open, allowing prospective participants to sign up ahead of the event date.
pros: Choice of two distances: full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km)
Located in the scenic destination of Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam

faqs.question: When is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is scheduled to take place on November 22, 2026. The event is held in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam, and runners can currently register for either the full marathon or half marathon distance ahead of this confirmed date.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?

faqs.question: Where does the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon take place?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon takes place in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, which is located in Vietnam. This venue serves as the host location for both the full marathon and half marathon distances offered as part of this event.
